title: CommonsGatewayBuildTransaction
description: claim → base SHA → exact paths → dependencies → candidate SHA → verification → integrated SHA or superseded. A claim is not a build. A PR is not an integration.

base_sha.description: git sha the claim was opened against. Stale base expires the claim unless explicitly renewed.

paths.description: Exact paths this transaction may touch. Overlap with another live CLAIMED/CANDIDATE transaction MUST stop integration.

dependencies.description: Other tx_id or event_id values this candidate needs.

candidate_sha.description: Required when state is CANDIDATE or later. Branch-head or local commit. Not main.

integrated_sha.description: Required when state is INTEGRATED. Live origin/main sha that contains the paths.

superseded_by.description: tx_id that replaced this one. Required when state is SUPERSEDED.

pr_url.description: Optional. A PR is evidence of a candidate, not integration.

verbatim_owner.description: Immutable owner-language block when this transaction implements a directive. Summaries MUST sit beside it, never replace it.
